observations.observation: Original page title is the generic 'Home' with lang 'en-gb' and meta names content-type/description/generator; the AI-built page is titled 'F N Souza Foundation — History & Works' with lang 'en' and meta charset/viewport/description. Neither has JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: generic home title becomes branded title

observations.observation: Original has 27 h1s (9 slider titles repeated three times) and 3 h2s; the AI-built page has a single h1 followed by six h2s and no h3.

tags.value: changed: multiple h1s and no h2 becomes structured h1 h2 h3

observations.observation: Original hero is a full-bleed painting about 900px tall, with a 60px bold white Cabin slide caption at bottom-left and no overlay; the AI-built hero is a 340px full-width band with a dark painterly CSS background image, a dark overlay, and a centred 52px weight-400 Georgia h1 spanning two lines.

tags.value: changed: full-bleed photo becomes short dark overlay hero
changed: bold slide caption becomes centered serif h1

observations.observation: The misspelled title 'Ciudad En Esapana' appears on both pages: in the original as an uppercase slide-caption h1 ('CIUDAD EN ESAPANA'), and in the AI-built page as a title-case item in the artworks list.

tags.value: kept: misspelled artwork title preserved

observations.observation: Original has a hero image carousel with 9 slides, 9 circular pagination bullets, and slider motion (1 animation, 11 transforms); the AI-built page has no carousel and lists the artwork titles as a static two-column italic serif list with hairline dividers.

tags.value: changed: nine-slide image carousel with bullets
changed: two-column italic serif title list

observations.observation: Original header is a semi-transparent band (rgba(1,1,0,0.53)) laid over the hero image, with centred brand and nav; the AI-built header is a 65px fixed-style top bar with a translucent dark background, a backdrop blur and a bottom hairline, with the brand on the left and the nav on the right.

tags.value: changed: centered overlay header becomes left brand right nav blurred bar
changed: backdrop blur on header

observations.observation: Both brands are text-only wordmarks with a 'History & Works' tagline. Original sets the brand in wide Krona One uppercase with an Arizonia script tagline flanked by rules; the AI-built page uses bold tracked uppercase sans 'F N SOUZA FOUNDATION' with a small grey sans tagline, and repeats 'HISTORY & WORKS' as a tracked peach uppercase hero subtitle.

tags.value: changed: krona and script wordmark becomes bold sans wordmark

observations.observation: Both navs have the same seven items (Home, About F N Souza, Family History, Gallery, Available for Sale, News, Contacts). Original sets them as a centred uppercase Cabin row with a red active 'HOME'; the AI-built nav is a right-aligned row of plain sans text items, two of them dropdown buttons with carets, and no visible active state.

tags.value: changed: centered uppercase row becomes right-aligned plain links with dropdowns
changed: red active home item

observations.observation: Original states the forgery/exoneration news as a long uppercase announcement line directly under the nav; the AI-built page puts the news item in a card in its own News section, with a lighter background, a thick orange left border and a 'Read the statement' outlined button.

tags.value: changed: uppercase line under nav becomes news card with button

observations.observation: A small red square with a white FontAwesome user icon is pinned to the top-right corner of the original.

tags.value: dropped: red square user icon in corner

observations.observation: Original section headings are small (20px bold) uppercase labels inside large black geometric shapes (box, circle, ring); the AI-built h2s are 34px weight-400 serif, left-aligned, each followed by a short orange underline bar.

tags.value: changed: uppercase labels in black shapes become serif h2 with orange underline bar

observations.observation: Both pages pair a portrait with the artist intro paragraph and a 'Read more' link. Original floats a small bordered 176×131 portrait left of a centred book antiqua paragraph with an inline underlined link; the AI-built page uses a two-column media block with a 370×275 slightly rounded portrait left and the h2, serif paragraph and an outlined 'Read more' button right.

tags.value: changed: floated small portrait becomes two-column media block with outline button

observations.observation: Original uses Open Sans (302) and Cabin (155) throughout, with serif only on the intro paragraph (book antiqua, 4 elements); the AI-built page pairs Georgia serif for headings and content (54) with system-ui sans for UI chrome (62).

tags.value: changed: open sans and cabin become georgia and system-ui pairing

observations.observation: Original body text is 16px Open Sans grey rgb(88,88,88) on white with a 30px line-height; the AI-built body is 17px with a 28.05px line-height in off-white rgb(238,232,223) on near-black rgb(18,17,16).

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 16px 30px becomes 17px 1.65
changed: grey on white becomes off-white on near-black

observations.observation: A one-line caption, 'Explore a significant collection of the latest works.', sits between the gallery heading and the image grid on the original.

tags.value: dropped: caption line above gallery grid

observations.observation: Both galleries have 6 thumbnails in two rows with varied widths at a constant height, cropped to fill. Original rows are 442px tall and fill the full ~1170px column with 30px gaps; the AI-built rows are 300px tall, and the second row leaves visible empty cells.

tags.value: changed: tall full-width rows become shorter rows with empty cells

observations.observation: Neither page puts captions or text overlays on the gallery thumbnails. Original wraps each in article/figure without figcaption; the AI-built page wraps each in an empty-text anchor with no figure.

tags.value: changed: article figure wrappers become plain anchors

observations.observation: On both pages the saturated expressionist paintings supply most of the colour, with neutral UI around them and no frames or shadows.

tags.value: kept: saturated paintings as main color without frames

observations.observation: Every image on both pages has an alt attribute (alt_missing 0). The original's alt values are empty strings; the AI-built page uses descriptive alts such as 'Last Supper' and 'Chess'.

tags.value: changed: empty alts become descriptive alts

observations.observation: Original contact form is a two-column layout (Name/Email/Phone left, tall Message textarea right) with borderless light-grey fields and placeholder-only labels; the AI-built contact form is a single stacked column (Name, Email, Message) of dark filled fields with thin borders, slight radius and muted grey labels above, and no placeholders.

tags.value: changed: two-column placeholder form becomes stacked dark labeled form

observations.observation: The AI-built page places a login form (Username, Password, Remember me, Log in), orange underlined account helper links and 'Sign in with Facebook' / 'Sign in with Google +' buttons beside the contact form in the same section.

tags.value: added: login form with social sign-in beside contact

observations.observation: Original's primary button is an outlined, square-cornered white 'SEND MESSAGE' with bold uppercase text and 17.5px 30px padding; AI-built buttons are thin-bordered ghost buttons about 39px tall with small sentence-case sans text, some with orange borders and some with light borders.

tags.value: changed: square uppercase outlined button becomes small ghost buttons

observations.observation: The AI-built DOM contains an unstyled browser-default 'Menu' button (bg rgb(239,239,239), padding 1px 6px), likely a hidden mobile toggle.

tags.value: added: unstyled default menu button

observations.observation: Both pages use mostly square corners. Original has 520 elements at 0 radius plus 11 pills/circles and 2 at 16+; the AI-built page has 99 at 0 and 18 at 1–7px, with no pills.

tags.value: changed: square corners become small rounding

observations.observation: Neither page uses box shadows or gradients. Original has no backdrop blur and uses 75 transitions, 1 animation and 11 transforms; the AI-built page has 1 backdrop blur, 6 transitions, and no animations or transforms.

tags.value: changed: many transitions become fewer transitions

observations.observation: Original layout is div/span heavy (196 divs, 187 spans) with flex on 1 element and grid on none; the AI-built page uses grid on 11 elements and flex on 5, with 17 divs.

tags.value: changed: flexbox-only becomes flex plus grid columns
changed: heavy div markup becomes minimal markup

observations.observation: Original landmarks are 3 header, 2 nav, 1 main, 1 section and 6 article elements, with no footer element; the AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 4 sections and a footer element, with no article or figure.

tags.value: changed: articles and many headers become sections and footer

observations.observation: Original has 60 inline style attributes and 1104 class uses (221 unique), with 21 stylesheets, 29 scripts and a base element; the AI-built page has 8 inline styles, 28 class uses (17 unique), a single embedded style block, 0 external stylesheets and 1 script.

tags.value: changed: many scripts and stylesheets become single inline style

observations.observation: Both footers show '© 2021' with Privacy Policy and the credit 'More Art Gallery Templates at TemplateMonster.com'. Original uses a solid black band with bold white uppercase text and a left-offset dim credit line; the AI-built footer is centred, small, muted sentence-case text with orange underlined links on the dark page background.

tags.value: changed: black uppercase band becomes centered muted text footer

observations.observation: Both pages centre content in a column inside a 1440px viewport. Original's column is about 1170px (x≈135–1305) on a 4120px-tall page with large gaps between sections; the AI-built column is 1068px (x=186–1254) on a 3147px-tall page with hairline section dividers and about 64px of top padding.

tags.value: changed: wide column becomes narrower centered column
changed: very tall page becomes much shorter page
changed: hairline rules with generous section padding

observations.observation: Both pages are image-led with little text (227 vs 201 words), and each has only one paragraph of real prose, the artist intro.

tags.value: kept: image-led with single intro paragraph

observations.observation: Original sets almost everything in uppercase (nav, headings, slide titles, button, footer); the AI-built page uses sentence or title case for headings, nav, buttons and footer, with uppercase only in the wordmark and the hero subtitle.

tags.value: changed: all-caps nav headings and buttons

observations.observation: Original palette is light (white, grey, black) with a single red accent rgb(232,43,24); the AI-built page is a dark theme (rgb(18,17,16) with rgb(27,25,23) panels) with a single burnt-orange accent rgb(226,102,58) used for heading rules, links, button borders and the news card edge.

tags.value: changed: light with red accent becomes dark with burnt orange
changed: bright red accent becomes burnt orange

observations.observation: The AI-built page uses a muted grey-beige rgb(163,155,143) for secondary text such as labels, the footer and the tagline.

tags.value: added: grey secondary copy color

observations.observation: Original uses FontAwesome icon glyphs (5 elements, 3 <i>) and 1 emoji, with no SVGs; the AI-built page has no icon font, no SVGs and no emoji, only text carets on the dropdowns.

tags.value: changed: icon fonts for social and ui glyphs

observations.observation: Original runs a single-page sequence of slider hero, artist intro, gallery, contact form and footer; the AI-built page adds sections, running hero, intro, gallery, artworks list, news, contact/login and footer, all left-aligned except the centred hero title and footer.

tags.value: changed: slider page sequence becomes added sections list and news
